record.question: Which of the following methods has been definitively proven to alone increase pregnancy-related mortality detection
options: Including a "pregnancy" check box on death certificates
Extending the temporal definition from 42 days postpartum to one year postpartum
Linking birth certificates to maternal death certificates
Requiring hospital administrators to complete death certificates independent of physicians
record.explanation: Studies of maternal death surveillance show that linking birth certificates to maternal death certificates identifies additional pregnancy-related deaths, whereas a checkbox alone did not reliably do so. The source's wording 'definitively proven to alone' is not verified here, so this is a low-confidence selection.
